name: atr_expansion_breakout_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional block orders (FII routing, VWAP algo completions, ETF rebalance flows) periodically create 5-second bars with range 2.5x+ the recent 10-minute ATR baseline. These are not random volatility spikes — they represent a genuine temporary imbalance between aggressive directional order flow and resting limit orders. When this expansion bar simultaneously creates a new session high (or low), the imbalance has overwhelmed ALL existing supply (or demand) accumulated since market open, signaling that the directional order flow is large enough to shift the session's price discovery level. NIFTY's high liquidity means the index can absorb most flows without such extreme bars — so when they occur, they carry information. The VWAP alignment and volume surge (2x+ the prior 5-minute average) confirm the expansion is institutional flow rather than a fat-finger or illiquidity artifact. Entry is on the expansion bar's close, betting that the flow that created the bar has not fully executed and will continue pushing the index for the next 30-90 seconds.
core_signal_oneliner: 5-second bar range exceeds 2.5x the 10-minute ATR baseline while simultaneously making a new session high/low, with 2x volume surge and VWAP alignment
